title: AppleOptimizer
description: Apple is a lightweight performance modpack focused on stability and high FPS

**AppleOptimizer** is a well-optimized performance modpack designed to provide a smoother Minecraft experience without compromising the vanilla feel. It includes stable and well-tested performance mods along with their required dependencies.



## ⚡ Features
- Improved FPS and performance
- Reduced lag and stuttering
- Clean and simple setup

🍏 **Why choose AppleOptimizer?**

This ain’t one of those bloated modpacks bro

AppleOptimizer is **OPTIMIZE ONLY** — no extra features, no gameplay changes, no random stuff you didn’t ask for.

Just:
- more FPS ⚡
- less lag 💨
- clean gameplay 🧠

No tweaking. No complicated settings.  
You launch the game… and it just runs better.

That’s it.  
Simple. Clean. Fast.
